notes: Login-gated platforms. They cannot be polled for new tasks without user credentials, so the app lists them for manual checking and links out. Hard-currency payouts only.

platforms.name: Mindrift (Toloka worker platform)
platforms.note: Global including Nigeria; per-project eligibility. Login required.

platforms.name: Appen / CrowdGen
platforms.note: 170+ countries including Nigeria; per-project. Login required.

excluded.name: uTest (Applause)
excluded.reason: PayPal-only payout, which the owner cannot receive. Kept out of the list rather than linked and wasted.

excluded.name: Freecash
excluded.reason: Offerwall/cent-level rewards, not 'truly rewarding'; gift-card payouts are low value. Contradicts the pay-quality goal.
